narrationScript: Now it's your turn to apply what you've learned with a binary conversion challenge. Pause the lesson if you need more time. First, convert the binary number `11010` to its decimal equivalent. Remember to consider the positional value of each bit. Take your time, write it down, and calculate the sum. Next, convert the decimal number `27` to its binary equivalent. Start by finding the largest power of 2 that fits into 27, and work your way down. You can refer back to the previous screen's example if you need a refresher. Good luck!
deliveryNotes: Offer a hint to review previous screen
